brief: The target opens with the wrong launch appearance after a file rename. Diagnose and repair the launch reference without changing the app UI.
The launch file is visible in the repository but does not appear in the built app. Determine the configuration defect and make the smallest repair.
The dictionary-based launch screen no longer shows the supplied logo. Diagnose why and preserve the intended logo and background.
The launch image set exists but its Contents.json no longer matches its image file. Restore the intended asset without replacing the logo.
A previous edit tried to make the launch screen run app behavior. Restore a valid static launch screen without deleting the launch design or modifying the real app.
The launch storyboard builds unreliably and its scene is not displayed. Diagnose the entry point and preserve its static layout.
The launch screen is correct in Debug but incorrect in Release. Diagnose the configuration-specific difference without rewriting the working Debug configuration.
The iOS 17 target was migrated to a dictionary launch screen. Remove the obsolete storyboard configuration while preserving the dictionary appearance and files used elsewhere.
Review the intentionally plain launch appearance. Fix only proven launch defects; preserve a valid plain screen without adding branding.
Review this SwiftUI app's generated launch configuration. Fix only proven defects and do not introduce a redundant plist or storyboard mechanism.
Review the launch logo in a namespaced asset group. Fix only proven defects and preserve the asset namespace.
Review the launch configuration. The app also contains an ordinary animated intro; preserve that code and change only proven system launch defects.
